title: WeChat Official Account Launches AI One-Click Formatting: Automatic Paragraphing, Generating Subheadings, and Matching Images in Three Steps

content_html:
WeChat Official Account platform has officially launched AI intelligent formatting capabilities, "One-click Formatting". When creators edit articles on the WeChat Official Account App on their mobile devices or on the web version of the backend, the system will automatically identify the content structure and pop up a formatting icon. Clicking it will complete the entire formatting process.

Three Core Features: From Paragraphs to Images, Fully Automated

One-click Formatting mainly addresses three frequent pain points. First, automatic optimization of paragraph structure - AI automatically divides paragraphs and adjusts spacing based on the article content, making the layout well-balanced. Second, automatically generating subheading styles - AI intelligently recognizes handwritten subheadings by creators, automatically bolding, increasing font size, and unifying colors, making the article structure clear at a glance.

The third feature focuses on image-text coordination. The system can intelligently adjust image size and alignment. When multiple consecutive images are inserted, it also supports automatically converting them into a carousel format. Currently, this feature offers two formatting styles: "Standard" and "Thin Font", and creators can freely adjust the theme color and text style.

For public account creators who often struggle with formatting, this is undoubtedly a practical productivity tool. WeChat is using AI capabilities to compress the most time-consuming manual work between "typing" and "publishing" into a single button press.

content_html_zh:
微信公众号平台正式上线AI智能格式化功能“一键格式化”。 当创作者在移动设备上的微信公众号App或网页版后台编辑文章时，系统会自动识别内容结构并弹出格式化图标。 单击它将完成整个格式化过程。

三大核心特征：从段落到图像，全自动

一键格式化主要解决三个常见痛点。 首先，自动优化段落结构——AI根据文章内容自动划分段落、调整间距，使布局更加平衡。 二是自动生成小标题样式——AI智能识别创作者手写的小标题，自动加粗、增大字号、统一颜色，让文章结构一目了然。

第三个特点注重图文协调。 系统可以智能调整图像大小和对齐方式。 当插入多个连续图像时，它还支持自动将它们转换为轮播格式。 目前，该功能提供“标准”和“细字体”两种格式样式，创作者可以自由调整主题颜色和文字样式。

对于经常为格式化而苦恼的公众号创建者来说，这无疑是一个实用的生产力工具。 微信正在利用人工智能功能，将“打字”和“发布”之间最耗时的手动工作压缩为按一次按钮。
